portal.home.sub.en: Review the frozen bilingual adaptation and approve each scene.
portal.home.sub.zh: 审核冻结的双语改编稿，并逐场作出决定。

portal.home.emptyBody.zh: 已提交的剧集将显示在这里。

portal.explain.body.en: Click a timestamp to leave precise feedback on one line. After Pulsar submits a revision, review the original request, Pulsar's response and the revised output before approving the changes.
portal.explain.body.zh: 点击时间码可对具体台词留下精确反馈。Pulsar 提交修订后，请依次核对原要求、Pulsar 的处理说明和修订结果，再批准修改。

portal.next.notSubmitted.en: Pulsar has not sent this episode yet

portal.next.waitingStaff.en: Your request was sent · Pulsar is revising {n} scene(s)
portal.next.waitingStaff.zh: 修改要求已发送 · Pulsar 正在修改 {n} 个场景

portal.next.approveEpisode.en: All scenes approved · approve the episode
portal.next.approveEpisode.zh: 所有场景已通过 · 请通过整集

portal.next.scenes.zh: 请审核剩余 {n} 个场景

review.workflow.preview.title.zh: 正在预览制片方审核界面

review.workflow.preview.body.en: This is the frozen version the producer sees. Review controls are disabled in staff preview.
review.workflow.preview.body.zh: 这是制片方看到的冻结版本。员工预览模式下审核操作不可用。

review.workflow.complete.body.en: The producer review is complete. This approved snapshot is final.
review.workflow.complete.body.zh: 制片方审核已完成，该批准快照为最终版本。

review.workflow.decide.body.en: Approve the current scene, or request changes and explain exactly what Pulsar should fix.
review.workflow.decide.body.zh: 通过当前场景，或要求修改并明确说明 Pulsar 需要调整的内容。

review.workflow.waiting.title.zh: 已要求修改 {n} 个场景

review.workflow.waiting.body.en: Your requests were sent. Pulsar must create and submit a revised version before you can finish this review.
review.workflow.waiting.body.zh: 您的修改要求已发送。Pulsar 需要创建并提交修订版本，之后才能完成审核。

review.workflow.final.title.en: All scenes approved — final approval needed
review.workflow.final.title.zh: 所有场景已通过 — 需要最终批准

review.workflow.final.body.en: Approve the episode to finish the review. This is a separate final action and does not happen automatically.
review.workflow.final.body.zh: 请通过整集以完成审核。这是独立的最终操作，不会自动完成。

review.workflow.approver.title.en: All scenes approved — waiting for an approver
review.workflow.approver.title.zh: 所有场景已通过 — 等待批准人

review.workflow.approver.body.en: Your scene review is complete. A producer approver must give the final episode approval.
review.workflow.approver.body.zh: 您的场景审核已完成，需要制片方批准人最终通过整集。

review.decision.approvedBody.en: This decision was saved. You can change it while the review remains open.
review.decision.approvedBody.zh: 该决定已保存。审核结束前仍可更改。

review.decision.pendingBody.en: No decision has been saved for this scene yet.
review.decision.pendingBody.zh: 本场景尚未保存审核决定。

review.request.placeholder.en: Be specific about meaning, tone, character voice, or wording…
review.request.placeholder.zh: 请具体说明含义、语气、人物口吻或措辞方面的问题…

review.request.help.en: Your note is sent to Pulsar with this scene and becomes their next action.
review.request.help.zh: 此备注将随场景发送给 Pulsar，并成为他们的下一步任务。

review.request.reasonRequired.en: Add a reason so Pulsar knows what to change.
review.request.reasonRequired.zh: 请填写原因，让 Pulsar 明确需要修改什么。

review.saved.approved.en: Scene {n} approved. Your decision was saved.
review.saved.approved.zh: 第 {n} 场已通过，决定已保存。

review.saved.alternative.en: Changes requested for scene {n}. Pulsar has been notified.
review.saved.alternative.zh: 已要求修改第 {n} 场，Pulsar 已收到通知。

review.saveFailed.en: Could not save the scene decision.
review.saveFailed.zh: 无法保存场景审核决定。

review.finalReady.en: Every scene is approved. This final action completes the producer review.
review.finalReady.zh: 所有场景均已通过。完成此最终操作后，制片方审核即告完成。

review.episodeBlocked.changes.en: Cannot approve yet: Pulsar must revise {n} scene(s).
review.episodeBlocked.changes.zh: 暂时无法通过：Pulsar 需要修改 {n} 个场景。

review.episodeBlocked.remaining.en: Cannot approve yet: decide the remaining {n} scene(s).
review.episodeBlocked.remaining.zh: 暂时无法通过：请先审核剩余 {n} 个场景。

review.previewDisabled.en: Staff preview — producer decision controls are disabled.
review.previewDisabled.zh: 员工预览 — 制片方审核操作已停用。

reviewStudio.workflow.body.en: Review the script in time order. Click any timestamp to comment on that exact line, or approve the scene when it is ready.
reviewStudio.workflow.body.zh: 请按时间顺序审核剧本。点击任意时间码可对该句留下意见；确认无误后通过当前场景。

reviewStudio.clickTimestamp.en: Click a timestamp to jump to a line and edit it on the right
reviewStudio.clickTimestamp.zh: 点击时间码定位台词，在右侧修改

reviewStudio.revisionThreadHelp.en: Review the complete change history before approving.
reviewStudio.revisionThreadHelp.zh: 批准前请核对完整修改记录。

reviewStudio.responsePending.en: Pulsar has not explained how this request was handled.
reviewStudio.responsePending.zh: Pulsar 尚未说明如何处理此要求。

reviewStudio.sceneApprovedHelp.en: Nothing is locked until final episode approval. Select any timestamp if you notice a specific issue.
reviewStudio.sceneApprovedHelp.zh: 整集最终批准前仍可提出问题。如发现具体问题，请选择相应时间码。

reviewStudio.selectedMomentHelp.en: The request will be pinned to this exact line and timestamp.
reviewStudio.selectedMomentHelp.zh: 修改要求将固定到这句台词和准确时间码。

reviewStudio.commentPlaceholder.en: Describe exactly what should change at this moment…
reviewStudio.commentPlaceholder.zh: 请准确说明此处需要如何修改…

reviewStudio.saved.request.en: Change request sent at {time}. Pulsar will see it on the same line.
reviewStudio.saved.request.zh: 已在 {time} 发送修改要求，Pulsar 将在同一句台词上看到。
